topic: Day 46 — reel — Trust can't be demanded and extended by the same relationship at once
text: Imbalance erodes trust as much as [betrayal] does.
caption:
You can extend trust or you can demand it, but not both without one side quietly resenting it.

Follow for one of these a day.
